import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
DEST = ROOT / "docs/engineering/evidence/hs0002-20260910"
DEST.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
previous = json.loads((DEST / "storage-map.json").read_text()) if (DEST / "storage-map.json").exists() else []
entries = []
for path in sorted(OUT.rglob("*")):
    relative = path.relative_to(OUT)
    if relative.name in {"v2-env.log", "v2-env.json"}:
        continue
    if "--exclude-v2" in sys.argv and relative.parts[0].startswith("v2-"):
        continue
    if len(relative.parts) > 1 and (not relative.parts[0].startswith(("codeaudit-rerun-", "v1-", "v2-")) or any(part.startswith(("tmp.", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".hypothesis")) for part in relative.parts)):
        continue
    if not path.is_file() or path.name.startswith(("draft-", "hs0003-", "hs0004-", "root-checkpoint-")):
        continue
    if path.suffix not in {".log", ".json", ".meta", ".md", ".py", ".diff", ".txt", ".sh", ".stdout", ".stderr", ".sha256"}:
        continue
    content = path.read_bytes()
    text = content.decode("utf-8")
    wrapped = len(relative.parts) > 1 or path.suffix in {".log", ".diff", ".meta", ".txt", ".py", ".sh"} or any(line.rstrip() != line for line in text.splitlines())
    name = str(relative) + ".json" if wrapped else str(relative)
    (DEST / name).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    if wrapped:
        (DEST / name).write_text(json.dumps({"original_filename": str(relative), "sha256": digest, "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        assert json.loads((DEST / name).read_text())["text"].encode() == content
    else:
        shutil.copyfile(path, DEST / name)
    entries.append({"original": str(relative), "stored": name, "sha256": digest, "wrapped": wrapped})
current_names = {entry["stored"] for entry in entries}
for entry in previous:
    if entry["stored"] not in current_names:
        (DEST / entry["stored"]).unlink()
(DEST / "storage-map.json").write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
assert all(path.stat().st_size <= 1048576 for path in DEST.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
print(f"PASS: {len(entries)} originals preserved; wrappers round-trip exact bytes; all files <=1MB")
